notes: Existential construction, plural. Ci sono polpette — there are meatballs.
Existential construction, singular. C'è un problema — there is a problem.
Standard response to 'come stai'. Bene = well (adverb), not 'good' (adjective).
Ogni always takes a singular noun: ogni anno, ogni estate, ogni giorno.
Anche precedes the pronoun or noun it modifies. Anche noi visitiamo Roma — we also visit Rome.
